Kiran D'Souza
QA Automation Engineer | Thane West
kiran.dsouza52@example.com | +91 9415820446

Results-driven QA Automation Engineer with a strong focus on reliable, maintainable test suites and CI-driven workflows. Skilled at designing automated test frameworks, reducing regression time, and improving defect detection through integration of end-to-end and API testing. Immediate joiner.

Experience
Saffron Bank, Jan 2026 - Present
QA Automation Engineer (Hybrid)
- Developed and maintained a TestNG-based automation framework for core banking web flows, implementing data-driven tests that reduced manual regression time by 60% and caught a critical reconciliation bug before release.
- Built Playwright end-to-end suites for customer onboarding and payments; ran nightly pipelines and reported stability metrics that improved pass-rate from 78% to 93% within two months.
- Automated API contract and functional checks using Postman collections integrated into CI, detecting 12 API regressions during pre-prod cycles.
- Collaborated with Dev and Ops in Agile sprints and documented test plans and release notes in Confluence to streamline sprint handoffs.

CartNest, Jan 2024 - Dec 2025
QA Automation Engineer (Remote)
- Designed and implemented Playwright automation for the checkout and promotions modules, increasing automated coverage of critical paths to 85% and reducing release rollback incidents by 40%.
- Led Test Automation efforts for cross-browser regression using Selenium hooks where needed; cut end-to-end test runtime by optimizing selectors and parallel execution.
- Integrated automated suites into Jenkins pipelines to enable gated deployments; monitored flakiness and introduced retries and stability reports.
- Authored sprint-testing checklists and collaborated in Agile ceremonies to align testing with product priorities.

Zentrix Labs, Jun 2023 - Dec 2023
Test Engineer (Onsite)
- Created Playwright test scenarios for a B2B dashboard, uncovering UX and data-sync issues that improved user acceptance test pass rates by 30%.
- Managed CI/CD test execution using Jenkins jobs, configured automated nightly runs, and reduced false positives by implementing environment health checks.
- Performed API sanity checks with Postman during integration phases and logged reproducible defects with steps and logs in Confluence.
- Supported Linux-based test environments and contributed to triage sessions with engineering teams.

Projects
- Payment Reconciliation Suite — Built automated Playwright and TestNG tests simulating multi-tenant payment flows, yielding a 50% reduction in manual verification effort pre-release.
- API Health Monitor — Developed Postman collections and simple Jenkins jobs to run smoke checks across environments and alert on degraded responses.

Skills
Languages: Selenium, Playwright
Testing: Test Automation, TestNG, Postman
CI/CD & Tools: Jenkins, Linux, Confluence
Methodologies: Agile

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS

Immediate joiner
